_doc: Hero classes, three per faction. attack/defense/power/knowledge: starting primaries. growth: weights for the primary gained at each level-up (deterministic cycle, see Hero). skills: starting secondary skills. skill_weights: how likely each skill is offered at level-up (skills absent here are never offered). trait: an always-on class specialty; mods use the hero modifier keys (src/heroes/hero_modifiers.gd) and per_level mods are multiplied by (level - 1). art: the class battle art, used automatically in combat. Its strength is base + per_power x Power (x Sorcery), and it is used on 1 + Knowledge / 2 rounds (see src/combat/hero_battle_effects.gd). Art kinds: strike (damage the most dangerous enemy stack), storm (damage every enemy stack), mend (heal the most wounded ally), rally (+morale for the round), hex (enemy stack deals less damage for the round), ward (your army takes less damage for the round).
